scope: Post-launch evidence tooling for the composition-5 launch window. One stdlib-only host script (post_launch_check.py) the controller runs after each Townfall launch to pull the three evidence files over anonymous FTP (one fresh curl connection per fetch, bounded timeouts), diff /data/plugins/UE4SS.log against the recorded 3-line baseline, parse runtime-status.txt state order, and classify the outcome (NOT_STARTED / FAILED_<stage> / ACTIVATED / ENGINE_READY / MODS_STARTED / UNKNOWN_NEW_LINES / FETCH_FAILED) with a per-classification recommended next action. Includes --from-dir fixture mode for host tests and --baseline-file override. NO console contact was made by this worker; all FTP behavior is exercised only through local fixtures and a loopback-free --from-dir mode. No nested subagents.

limits: No console contact, no FTP fetch against the real console, no launch performed: the FTP path is exercised only as constructed argv (curl is invoked only in --from-dir-free live mode, never executed by the host tests; live mode is for the controller after the user launches).

Baseline line 2 is format+ledger reconstructed, not a verbatim console readback (see baseline_three_lines). The baseline prefix rules (PATH_TEST:/ACTIVATION_TEST:/DIAG:) keep classification correct even if the exact bytes differ.

The script is stateless between runs: UE4SS.log and the aligned-entry log are append-only, so failure-line and observer-event counts are cumulative across launches (playbook O5); per-launch attribution relies on runtime-status.txt session replacement (O_TRUNC) and is labeled accordingly.
Classification is evidence interpretation, not acceptance: rung advancement stays governed by FIRST-RUN-PLAYBOOK section 5.
